messages:
maria_docs: heads-up: i'm editing the 'audit log retention' doc to add a short user-facing example for legal holds and the minimal SDK call for customers to place a log under hold. want to keep the wording plain and avoid implying immutability. @lee_security @anita_compliance quick sanity check?

lee_security: thanks. prefer 'preserve' or 'retain under hold' instead of 'lock' or 'immutable'. also add a note that when customer KMS is in use, the retained item is encrypted with their key while on hold.

anita_compliance: from compliance side: we should state that holds suspend automated deletion (TTL) for the specific records, and that only authorized roles can apply or remove holds. suggest a one-liner: "Logs placed on legal hold are retained until the hold is removed by authorized personnel or by a court order resolution."

sam_eng: ok i'll prepare tiny snippets for both Python and Node that are safe for public docs (no internal headers). keep them minimal: url, bearer token header, and payload. example payload will include reason and optional expires_at=null to indicate indefinite hold.

maria_docs: draft language i'm thinking of inserting: 

"Plain language: When a legal hold is applied, we preserve the relevant audit log entries and pause automatic deletion for those items until the hold is lifted by an authorized person or legal resolution."

SDK example (minimal):
```python
# place a log item on hold (python)
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/holds",
  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},
  json={"entry_id": "log-98765", "action": "apply", "reason": "discovery - case 42"}
)
print(resp.status_code)
```

```js
// place a log item on hold (node)
await fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/holds", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Authorization": `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ entry_id: "log-98765", action: "apply", reason: "discovery - case 42" })
});
```

maria_docs: short bullet under snippet: "Requires role: `audit:hold`. Held entries bypass configured TTL-based purges. When customer-managed KMS is enabled, held entries are encrypted with the customer's key while preserved."

lee_security: nit: change endpoint path to `/audit/logs/holds` to match our API structure. also change payload field `entry_id` -> `log_id` for consistency. otherwise +1.

anita_compliance: add a short sentence linking to the SOC2 appendix for retention rules. also recommend we note that holds are auditable actions (who applied/removed).

sam_eng: will update snippets accordingly and push to the PR branch. i'll also include a tiny response example (200 OK) so it's clear what customers should expect.

docs-bot: PR 4178 created: branch docs/legal-hold-example. CI: running linkcheck...

maria_docs: thanks. i'll incorporate lee's endpoint + field changes, and anita's auditability note. merging after linkcheck passes. link reference: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2#audit-preservation
